coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 8 low-code/no-code platforms (Mendix, OutSystems, PowerApps, Bubble, Webflow, Xano, GrapesJS, Creatio). Coverage includes: official homepages + pricing pages (T0 primary capture); official docs, API refs, changelogs (T1); analyst reports from Gartner/Forrester + review aggregates (G2/Capterra/TrustRadius) (T2); third-party comparisons, teardowns, funding announcements, HCI/UX research (T3). Deduped across 50+ sources; prioritized review platforms (Bubble/Webflow on G2 have 975+/64 verified reviews; TrustRadius/Capterra for OutSystems/Mendix). Key finding: all major platforms now emphasize AI-assisted development as differentiator (2026 trend); HCI pain evidence concentrated in usability/customization tradeoffs. Analyst consensus: Mendix + OutSystems + PowerApps + Appian + Pega are Gartner Leaders 2025; SMB alternatives (Bubble, Webflow, Xano) show strong community reviews but pricing opacity. Coverage sweeps enterprise-grade (high complexity, high cost, enterprise sales) and SMB-friendly (low cost, rapid deployment, community). No significant gaps identified; coverage is broad across homepages, pricing, docs, reviews, comparisons, analyst reports, and HCI research.
